channel.title: Sonneblom Digitaal: Kids Learning Printables
channel.description: Kids Learning Printables from Sonneblom Digitaal

item.title: Preschool Learning Bundle: Tracing
item.description: Learning and good habits in one bundle: 80 preschool tracing pages, 106 math worksheets and a full set of chore, routine and reward charts. Perfect for homeschool, after-school practice and busy parents.

item.title: Holiday Math Mystery Pictures Bundle
item.description: Three seasons of solve-color-reveal math fun: 54 mystery picture worksheets for Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas, each at 3 levels (within 10, within 20, multiplication), with answer keys.

item.title: 106 Printable Math Worksheets Bundle
item.description: 106 printable math worksheets for kindergarten to grade 4, with answer keys for every sheet. Great for homeschool, extra practice, summer review and classroom centres.

item.title: Preschool Tracing Bundle
item.description: A colourful 80-page preschool learning pack for ages 3 to 5. Perfect for pre-K, kindergarten readiness, homeschool, daycare and busy binders.

item.title: Halloween Activity Pack for Kids
item.description: Not-too-spooky Halloween fun for kids aged 4 to 10! Print as many copies as you need for the family, a classroom or a Halloween party.

item.title: Kids Chore Chart Printable
item.description: Help your kids build good habits with colourful picture chore charts and routine charts. Pictures on every job mean even children who can't read yet know exactly what to do.
